summary: Corrected a statement of my own from the previous turn rather than leaving it standing. Reading the two retained harnesses directly shows that the harness which repeatedly reports near_node_self_voter true and the one that never does both call the same function on the same node's own GetConfiguration, from the same starting point after the demotion future returns, so their sampling is equivalent and cannot carry the difference I had named. The corrected account keeps everything else: three executions of the same fixed extended-window experiment agree on the whole settled sequence (confirmation succeeds with only the demoted non-voter reachable, succeeds again while a competing leader already leads and the answering leader is still Leader inside its 20s lease, that competitor's write absent from the old leader's FSM, and the control losing leadership at the lease), all four comparisons hold, and the scoped defect claim and its bound stand unchanged on the voter-only quorum arithmetic and the unfiltered vote path. The unexplained field remains three for three in one harness against zero for seven runs of the other on the same executor, now recorded as an unexplained divergence rather than an artefact of sampling, with gap 1ec42e5bd80546ba910c8d8d7321fd6f-gap-1 owning it and the explicit statement that no claim in the run depends on it. No further work was submitted; the allocation that remains is shorter than a construction, execution and interpretation cycle.
